FAQ

Questions, answered

How much does ceramic coating cost?

It depends on vehicle size and coating type. Expect to invest between $700 and $1,500 for a complete application — including paint prep, correction, and multi-layer protection.

How long does a ceramic coating last?

A professionally applied coating can last 3 to 10 years, depending on the brand, coating type, and how well it's maintained.

Do you bring your own water and electricity?

Yes. Our units contain water and are ready to perform any job that requires electricity.

How long does a detail take?

Usually 1 to 6–7 hours depending on the service and the vehicle's condition. Paint correction and coatings may take longer — you'll get a clear estimate when scheduling.

Will a car wash ruin my ceramic coating?

Automatic washes with brushes can wear down or scratch coatings. Touchless washes are generally fine, but hand washing is still best.

Do I need an appointment?

Appointments are recommended. Same-day appointments are welcome when available, but booking in advance is best.
